title: Covering Hypercube $mB^n$
summary: The Alon--Füredi theorem determines the minimum number of hyperplanes needed to cover every nonzero vertex of the Boolean cube while avoiding the origin. We study hyperplane coverings with multiplicity for the generalized hypercube $mB^n=\{0,1,\ldots,m\}^n$. Our main result is a polynomial multiplicity theorem extending the theorem of Sauermann and Wigderson to $mB^n$, with sharp degree bounds for polynomials having prescribed high-order zeros.
